pumac-2018-finals-a-02.prompt: Find all functions $f:\mathbb R^+\to\mathbb R^+$ such that for all $x,y\in\mathbb R^+$ it holds that $$f\left(xy\left(\frac1x+\frac1y+\frac1{x+y}\right)\right)=f\left(xy\left(\frac1x+\frac1y\right)\right)+f(x)f\left(\frac y{x+y}\right).$$

pumac-2018-finals-a-03.prompt: We say that the prime numbers $p_1,\dots,p_n$ construct the graph $G$ if we can assign to each vertex of $G$ a natural number whose prime divisors are among $p_1,\dots,p_n$ and there is an edge between two vertices in $G$ if and only if the numbers assigned to the two vertices have a common divisor greater than $1$. What is the minimal $n$ such that there exist prime numbers $p_1,\dots,p_n$ which construct any graph $G$ with $N$ vertices.
